turns.content: My sister and I haven't really spoken in two years after a fight I can barely reconstruct now. Our mom's birthday is coming up and someone has to decide whether to break the silence.
You want to reconnect with your sister. You know what you must do. You will reach out to her.
I still have her number. I've typed and deleted a 'hey' more times than I want to admit.
You already know her number is still saved. You will send the message.
Part of me feels like reaching out first means admitting I was the one who was wrong, and I'm not sure I believe that.
You feel that. You want to reconnect. You will send the message, it's clear what you must do.
If I don't do it before the birthday, I think the silence just becomes the permanent shape of things.
You know that's true. You will send the message now.
